labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: FreeCAD is a general-purpose parametric 3D computer-aided design (CAD) modeler and a building information modeling (BIM) software application with finite element method (FEM) support.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Freecad

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG FREECAD_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=FreeCAD \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/freecad-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  if [ -z ${FREECAD_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    FREECAD_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/releases/tags/${FREECAD_VERSION}" \
    | jq -r 'first(.assets[].browser_download_url | select(test("Linux-x86_64-py311.AppImage")))') && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/freecad.app -L \
    "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" && \
  cd /tmp && \
  chmod +x freecad.app && \
  ./freecad.app --appimage-extract && \
  mv \
    squashfs-root \
    /opt/freecad && \
  echo "**** launcher ****" && \
  echo \
    "#!/bin/bash" \
    > /usr/bin/freecad && \
  echo \
    "xterm -e /opt/freecad/AppRun \"\${@}\"" \
    >> /usr/bin/freecad && \
  chmod +x /usr/bin/freecad && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3000

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
FreeCAD 1.1.4 is the last planned maintenance release in the 1.1.x series. It includes two security fixes addressing file-handling vulnerabilities that can be triggered by opening a maliciously crafted FCStd file. All previously-released versions are affected by these issues, so we strongly recommend that all users upgrade, especially anyone who opens FreeCAD files from untrusted or unknown sources.

## How to download
The assets section below is automatically populated as the builds complete: if you don't see a download for your system, please be patient, the builds can take several hours to complete. Windows and macOS builds are signed by The FreeCAD project association AISBL.

## What's Changed
* fix COIN3D_MICRO_VERSION regex for coin 4.0.10 by @moench-tegeder in #30899 (backported by PR [#31571](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31571))
* core: Improve performance of fps label by @ipatch in #29628 (backported by PR [#31657](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31657))
* Gui: Fix visibility icons for link group sub-items by @maxwxyz in #31559 (backported by PR [#31684](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31684))
* TechDraw: Projection Group jumps to origin by @WandererFan in #27094 (backported by PR [#31687](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31687))
* [Gui] fix TinkerCAD nav style to consistently show the context menu … by @Syres916 in #31631 (backported by PR [#31706](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31706))
* Fix regression with 3mf thumbnail by @sliptonic in #30682 (backported by PR [#31717](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31717))
* BIM: fix site ReferenceError when creating project with default structure by @Roy-043 in #31747 (backported by PR [#31756](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31756))
* Gui: Fix Sketcher toolbar state not persisting across workbench switches by @ayyaz20003 in #28674
* Gui: fix toolbar icon size reset after stylesheet reload by @Bojan9597 in #28998 (backported by PR [#31762](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31762))
* BIM: fix another error in #30001 by @Roy-043 in #31761 (backported by PR [#31768](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31768))
* TechDraw: allow precise surface finish symbol placement by @WandererFan in #31635 (backported by PR [#31794](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31794))
* Draft: fix format_object for Links by @Roy-043 in #31800 (backported by PR [#31814](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31814))
* [Part] Fix seg fault when opening file with faulty geometry by @Syres916 in #31812 (backported by PR [#31837](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31837))
* Gui: Hide ShowPlane with its object by @maxwxyz in #31871 (backported by PR [#31946](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31946))
* Replace deprecated QImage::mirrored by QImage::flipped by @Lgt2x in #27563 (backported by PR [#31989](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/31989))
* [TD]expose scrubEdges to Python by @WandererFan in #29009 (backported by PR [#32013](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32013))
* TechDraw: Avoid unnecessary approximation of bspline curve by @WandererFan in #29648 (backported by PR [#32063](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32063))
* [TD]Line format fixes by @WandererFan in #29430 (backported by PR [#32268](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32268))
* BIM: BimViews: fix IfcType error for WorkingPlaneProxy in Std_Group by @Roy-043 in #32055 (backported by PR [#32419](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32419))
* Draft: flatten SVG faces (improved) by @Roy-043 in #32416 (backported by PR [#32422](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32422))
* Gui: Fix splash screen rendering on macOS by @maxwxyz in #32598 (backported by PR [#32617](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32617))
* Draft: fix midpoint snap for hyperbola by @Roy-043 in #32499 (backported by PR [#32503](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32503))
* TechDraw: fix PAT hatch color and width by @WandererFan in #32791 (backported by PR [#32796](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32796))
* BIM: Prevent flipping of v1.0.2 columns by @Roy-043 in #32244 (backported by PR [#32810](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32810))
* Gui: fix splash screen positioning (wrong window flags) by @ElementW in #32834 (backported by PR [#32847](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32847))
* [Sketcher] Fix `SketchObject::setConstruction` for external geometries by @AjinkyaDahale in #32891 (backported by PR [#32906](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32906))
* TechDraw: honour Print Center Marks preference by @WandererFan in #31779 (backported by PR [#32941](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32941))
* (cp) Gui: Set alpha value to 255 of default colors by @maxwxyz in #31729 (backported by PR [#32978](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32978))
* FEM: Avoid ZipSlip by @chennes in #31878 (backported by PR [#32980](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32980))
* Fem: Fix constraint symbol paths by @marioalexis84 in #32176 (backported by PR [#32981](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/32981))
* App: Avoid ZipSlip in VRML texture loading by @chennes in #33017 (backported by PR [#33019](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/pull/33019))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/compare/1.1.3...1.1.4
